name: Summary
summary: The Grey Falcon (Falco hypoleucos) is one of Australia's rarest birds of prey, found in arid and semi-arid inland Australia.

name: Taxonomy
taxonomy: The Grey Falcon was described by ornithologist John Gould in 1852, based on a specimen collected in South Australia.

name: Ecology
ecology: Grey Falcons prey primarily on birds, taken in the air after a fast pursuit, and occasionally on small mammals and reptiles.
